summary: CallMissed is a multi-model API platform (LLM, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, embeddings) billed in prepaid credits. New accounts start with 1,000 free API credits (1 credit = ₹1 ≈ US$0.0104). The Free plan is free forever and includes 11 free-tier models (6 LLMs, 1 speech-to-text, 2 text-to-speech, 2 embedding models; no image model) with a limit of 60 requests per minute.
claim_steps: Sign up at console.callmissed.com with email or Google
Create an API key under Settings → API Keys

social_proof.title: CallMissed pricing — plans, credits and model rates
social_proof.text: Every account gets 1,000 free API credits on signup. The Free plan is free forever with 1,000 API credits — that is your trial. The Free plan includes 11 free-tier models: 6 LLMs, 1 speech-to-text, 2 text-to-speech and 2 embedding models. 1 credit = ₹1 ≈ US$0.0104 (US$1 = ₹96).

social_proof.title: Getting started in 5 minutes
social_proof.text: Sign up at console.callmissed.com with email or Google. Add credits from the Billing page — a free tier is available for testing. Create an API key under Settings → API Keys.
